notes.title: Vert Update
notes.notes: -Work done to vert landing sensors to allow for more consistent SPINE transfers and better hold into transition overall. It's a tad bit more aggressive to get closer to the Streets way but we can successfully ride the main test map bowl for long periods without getting thrown to the lower flats.

notes.title: Vert Update
notes.notes:
- Adjustments to vert magnets.
- Added, Anti-Case sensors. A small auto tuck up happens sometimes. Dropping into bowls should be more successful

notes.title: Trick Update
notes.notes:
-Improvements to physics-based tricks. (They don't flip you over up-side-down any more)
-Tricks are now triggered the same as BMX Streets
-Manny input is the same as BMX Streets 
-Nosey input is the same as BMX Streets
-Tuck removed from trigger since we have normal double trigger Tuck-Ups now

notes.title: Manny/Nosey Update
notes.notes:
- Manny/Nosey input now act the same as BMX Streets. A hold point is required
- Added Barspins with Bumpers

notes.title: Wheel Update
notes.notes:
-Minor changes to flip stabilizers, Nosey/Manny stabilizers
-Tire Skid Marks

notes.title: Whip Update
notes.notes:
- Changes to the whip so it takes a more realistic orbit
- Smoothing to Air/Vert surface mapping

notes.title: OVERALL UPDATE
notes.notes:
-Performances boost
-Solution to pathing Wobble/Jitter
-Wallride pop on and off super butter now
-Attempt to add lighting fix code line
-Drone int/out input bug fix
-Drone audio
-Barspin audio

notes.title: Manny Update
notes.notes: -Changes and edits to Mannys. Manny pivots should be smoother

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.notes:
- Added TUCK UP control with Right Trigger
- Fixed grinding issue. Its smoother again

notes.title: Transition Sensor Update
notes.notes:
- improvements to transition sensors
- camera movement during transition airs

notes.title: Transition Update
notes.notes:
- Improved transition sensors
- Small spin assist into vert landings
- performance upgrades
- Updates to BMX visual
